N° 14AI setup service for small businesses2026

How to use Zeste

For owners of small businesses in Africa and the diaspora (tailors, salons, garages, restaurants, schools, transport, construction, shops) who want AI to handle office work without learning it themselves.

Open Zeste ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Open the Zeste page and choose French or English.

2

Take the five-question check: one minute, nothing is sent.

3

Read the tasks it suggests for your business.

4

Watch the 90-second film with the sound on.

5

Book the free diagnostic or choose a plan.

02

Features

01

Overview

Messages, quotes, payment reminders and bookkeeping handled with AI, set up and monitored by a person.

STEPS

  1. Choose your language
  2. Turn the sound on if you like
  3. Start the check
02

Office-work check

Five questions about evenings spent on paperwork, quotes and unpaid invoices. The result lists the tasks to set up first.

STEPS

  1. Choose your trade
  2. Answer yes or no
  3. Book the diagnostic
03

Explainer film

90 seconds of paper animation: you speak, Claude prepares, you approve.

STEPS

  1. Play with sound
  2. Turn on captions
  3. Share it with a partner
04

Eight tasks

Each card shows what you say, what Claude prepares, and an example from a real trade, from supplier invoices to customer reviews.

STEPS

  1. Find your task
  2. Read or listen to the example
  3. Ask for it during setup
05

Pricing

Free diagnostic, a setup session, setup with 30 days of follow-up, and a team plan, in FCFA or dollars.

STEPS

  1. Switch the currency
  2. Compare what each plan includes
  3. Book
03Tips
  • Start with one task you do every week.
  • Approve every message before it is sent.
  • The Claude subscription is paid to Anthropic; my price covers setup and follow-up.
04FAQ
Do I need a computer?

No. A phone with internet is enough.

Does it work with WhatsApp and mobile money?

Through copy and paste. The setup shows you how.

Does it replace an accountant?

No. It prepares documents; you or your accountant decide.

What does the code unlock?

The full setup guide, given to clients after the setup session.
